content:
The project is envisioned as a multifunctional residential model, harmoniously combining private family living spaces with rental apartments. The design aims to optimize real estate utilization while ensuring privacy, comfort, and a high quality of living for the homeowners.

The architectural solution focuses on flexible spatial planning, creating independence between functional areas while maintaining overall connectivity. Natural light, ventilation, and material selection are carefully considered to create a modern, comfortable, and sustainable living environment for long-term use.
